name: Quick note
desc: A note that keeps itself: rich text filling the window, a footer of buttons, Ctrl+S to save, a pin that keeps it on top, and a question before closing with unsaved changes. Rules and states, very little code.

windows.name: Main
windows.title: Quick note
windows.status:
msg | Not saved yet | grow icon=E70B
where | Documents\Quick note.md | right dim
windows.titleitems: pin | glyph | E718 | right tip="Keep it on top" toggle | ToggleTop()
windows.flows:
note Change -> state dirty
note Change -> dirty
saveBtn Click -> call SaveNote
windows.script:
NoteFile := A_MyDocuments "\Quick note.md"
onTop := false

; What was written last time, if there is any.
; Closing with unsaved changes asks Save / Don't save / Cancel -- the window's
; Keys and closing settings (Window tab): ask when there are unsaved changes,
; saved by SaveNote. "note Change -> dirty" is what marks them.
LoadNote() {
    global g, note, NoteFile
    if FileExist(NoteFile)
        note.Value := FileRead(NoteFile, "UTF-8")
    MainState("clean")
    g.Dirty := false
}
SaveNote() {
    global g, note, NoteFile
    try FileDelete(NoteFile)
    FileAppend(note.Value, NoteFile, "UTF-8")
    MainState("clean")
    g.Dirty := false                  ; nothing unsaved: closing asks nothing
    g.Status("msg", "Saved at " FormatTime(, "HH:mm"))
    return true
}
ToggleTop() {
    global g, onTop
    onTop := !onTop
    g.AlwaysOnTop(onTop)
    g.Toast(onTop ? "Kept on top" : "Not on top any more", 1500)
}
